description_en: Rolls back the container version of edge resources under an application to a historical version
description_zh: 调用RollbackApplication回滚应用下边缘资源的容器版本，回退到历史版本
name: RollbackApplication

parameters.help_en:
The application ID.

The AppId is returned by the CreateApplication operation. FromAppVersion and ToAppVersion must be existing versions created by calling CreateAppVersion. You can call ListAppVersions to query the versions
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。

AppId 来源于 CreateApplication 返回值；FromAppVersion 和 ToAppVersion 必须是通过 CreateAppVersion 创建的已有版本，可调用 ListAppVersions 查询
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The version number to be rolled back
parameters.name: from_app_version

parameters.help_en: The target version number. By default, the application is automatically rolled back to the previous version
parameters.help_zh: 目标版本号。默认自动回滚到上一版本
parameters.name: to_app_version

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for the asynchronous rollback operation. Unit: seconds. Default value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 回滚的异步操作超时时间。单位：秒。默认值：300
parameters.name: timeout
